(async () => { await import('/sandbox/campaign_open_doors.js'); const r = await OD.ready(); await OD.sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify(r); })()

(async () => { const a = await OD.talk('guard', 'Corporal Hale', 'Halt!'); const b = await OD.talk('guard', 'Corporal Hale', 'All quiet on the bridge'); return JSON.stringify({ first: a.pages.length, second: b.pages }); })()
OD.alone().then((a) => { OD.after1 = a; CI.expect(a.level === 'emberfall', 'back in the town after the tour'); return JSON.stringify(a); })

(async () => { const routes = []; for (const b of OD.BUILDINGS) for (const r of await OD.building(b, { wait: 2500 })) routes.push(r.route + (r.kept ? ' kept' : ' built') + ' ' + r.travelMs); return JSON.stringify(routes); })()

OD.alone().then((a) => { const b = OD.after1; CI.expect(JSON.stringify(a.memory) === JSON.stringify(b.memory) && JSON.stringify(a.scene) === JSON.stringify(b.scene), 'no leak: the town alone after a second tour of every door and stair has the GPU memory, programs and scene of the town after the first: ' + JSON.stringify([b, a])); return JSON.stringify({ after1: b, after2: a }); })

(() => { const t = OD.times; const max = (a) => Math.max(...a); const med = (a) => [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y)[a.length >> 1]; CI.expect(t.kept.length >= 40 && max(t.kept) <= 650, 'a level set aside (the town, the last room, the other floor) comes back in the fades plus at most 0.3 s: ' + t.kept.join(' ')); CI.expect(t.first.length >= 10 && max(t.first) <= 700, 'a room built ahead while the player stood by its door or stair opens in the fades plus at most 0.35 s: ' + t.first.join(' ')); CI.expect(CI.trips.every((r) => r.programsAtArrival === r.programsAfterPlay), 'no program compiled after any arrival'); return JSON.stringify({ kept: { n: t.kept.length, median: med(t.kept), max: max(t.kept) }, first: { n: t.first.length, median: med(t.first), max: max(t.first), all: t.first }, built: t.built, failed: CI.failed, summary: CI.summary() }); })()
